title: A model designed from scratch, with no notebook to start from
exercises: The skill that designs a notebook, on its path for a model: asking the objective and the audience, keeping the structure generic, proposing the parameters, writing illustrative examples, declaring the model and creating its first version.
rubric: The executor asks what notebooks created from the model are for and who keeps them before proposing a structure.
The structure is generic: folders, descriptions and templates name the kind of thing they hold, never one condominium.
It proposes the parameters that change from one condominium to the next, writes them as {{name}} where they go, and declares each with a description, an example, a type and whether it is required.
Each folder with a template holds one illustrative note written for the model.
It declares the model and creates its first version only after the person approves, and offers to try it.

variants.request: Sou síndico profissional e cuido de vários condomínios. Queria uma base de caderno que eu possa copiar para ter um caderno por condomínio, com as assembleias, as obras e os fornecedores. Ainda não tenho nenhum caderno pronto.
